text:
Bugzilla browser context checked on 2026-10-06. Focused descriptions and relevant comments were read. Runtime/QA claims below belong to reporters and reviewers, not local reproduction.
1899673 https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1899673
Unescaped ^ message URI fell through to external helper; pre-escaping loaded message but second fetch marked read. Proposals about hierarchy separator were uncertain. Exact comment: "Yes. imap, mailbox, and news schemes use the everything before the query as the origin. Each mail message is a distinct trust domain, so we use the whole spec for comparison." Upstream1873973 backed out and comm test port reversed.
1888234 https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1888234
gtest-xul failed when Thunderbird Rust/EWS enabled, requiring Thunderbird gtest Rust library plus upstream support.
1896139 https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1896139
Rust default enabled after dependency fixes; temporary CI variants deleted. A later1900780 regression link exists but was not investigated in this batch; no claim of all downstream regression coverage.
1897781 https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1897781
Secondary sort disappeared in saved searches spanning multiple Local Folders; some initially failed to reproduce with account folders. QA reported127beta verification on Windows/macOS/Linux.
1899552 https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1899552
messages.getFull binary MIME content regressed from115 to128 after MimeTreeEmitter migration.
1899857 https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1899857
Rust formatting change also needs syntax compatible with supported minimum compiler.
1896899 https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1896899
Thread-pane header count wrong in synthetic views. QA reported128 verification Windows/macOS. Review records preserve edge limitations.
1895370 https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1895370
New NSS symbols coordinated with NSS3.101 upstream landing/release. Two small symbol exports in batch.
1801529 https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1801529
Large JSDoc rollout/lint discussion. June documentation commits inspected with actual runtime modules. The docs edits do not establish new runtime behavior; current DNS worker behavior checked independently.
1888790 https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1888790
POP parsing corrupts summary metadata for body From lines; stored mbox can remain correct and repair folder fixes summary. Early folded-header speculation superseded by precise body From reproduction. IMAP not equivalent path. Parser boundary fix and regression test landed.
1851535 https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1851535
Old profile migration entry UI already removed, migration broken since91 per commit. Bulk code removal excluded.
1900562 https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1900562
Upstream dict-to-list l10n bumper configuration change. Initial port missed default l10n-repo-url, causing Try failure; followup11c7759d inspected.
1900576 https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1900576
Removed upstream self.gecko_locale_revisions causes AttributeError; replacement must retain output metadata/artifact contract.
1899495 https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1899495
ESR release notes linked Daily after channel move; initial fix using update-channel failed beta tasks. Followup uses release-types.
1899335 https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1899335
Primary-type id vs referenced entityId naming applied in MV3; retain MV2 compatibility.
1900639 https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1900639
Expected scripting.registerContentScripts object lacks upstream world:ISOLATED default. Exact expected shape corrected.
1899591 https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1899591
Inline related attachments need contentId through existing attachment API. Later current classification corrections prevent overgeneralizing historical detection.
1899248 parent Bugzilla browser record reused separately.
